what_this_is: the evaluated test set's annotated metabolites as matching descriptors rather than as structures, so that all five declared matching criteria remain computable by a reader who does not hold the corpus sources' licences

fields.canonical_sha256: SHA-256 of the RDKit canonical SMILES; equality decides the canonical-SMILES criterion exactly
fields.inchikey: the full InChIKey; equality decides that criterion, and its first 14 characters decide the stereochemistry-blind one
fields.tautomer_key: the tautomer-aware key this work defaults to
fields.morgan_bits: the on-bits of a folded Morgan fingerprint, radius 2, 1024 bits; equality of the bit sets decides Tanimoto = 1

not_included: the metabolite structures themselves, and any representation from which they could be recovered
substrates: kept as structures in results/test_references.json, because reproducing the comparison means running a predictor on them and a hash cannot be run on
